entries.en: The aerograph stopped recording halfway through the balloon's ascent.
entries.zh: 气球上升到半途时，航空气象记录仪停止了记录。

entries.en: The aerographer spread the weather charts across the ship's briefing table.
entries.zh: 那位军方高空气象观察员把气象图铺在了船上的简报桌上。

entries.en: A small aerolith occupied the centre of the museum's newest display.
entries.zh: 博物馆最新展陈的中央摆着一块小石陨石。

entries.en: The aerologist requested another set of balloon measurements before updating the forecast.
entries.zh: 那位高空气象学家要求再取得一组气球观测数据，然后才更新预报。

entries.en: In the novel, the king's reliance on aeromancy frustrates his cautious advisers.
entries.zh: 小说中，国王对气候占卜的依赖让他那些谨慎的顾问十分懊恼。

entries.en: We could not read the aerometeorograph's chart until the damaged cover was removed.
entries.zh: 直到破损的盖子被移开，我们才能读到航空气象记录仪的记录图。

entries.meaningZh: 模型飞机制作者〔英式英语〕
entries.en: The aeromodeller brought a half-finished wooden wing to the club meeting.
entries.zh: 那位模型飞机制作者带着一片尚未完工的木制机翼来参加俱乐部聚会。

entries.en: A cracked mounting bracket kept the aeromotor out of service for a week.
entries.zh: 一个开裂的安装支架使那台飞机用发动机停用了一周。

entries.en: High-school chemistry had not prepared me for the mathematics in my aeronomy course.
entries.zh: 高中化学并没有让我做好应对高层大气物理学课程中那些数学内容的准备。

entries.en: The milliner pinned a strip of aerophane around the hat's crown.
entries.zh: 制帽师围着帽冠别了一条细丝纱。

entries.en: As an aerophobe, Victor chose the overnight train rather than the short flight.
entries.zh: 维克托有飞行恐惧症，所以选择了通宵火车，而不是那趟短途航班。

entries.en: The quartet paired an aerophone with three bowed string instruments.
entries.zh: 那个四重奏组合将一件气鸣乐器与三件弓弦乐器搭配在一起。

entries.en: Low clouds forced us to postpone the aerophotography until Friday.
entries.zh: 低云迫使我们把航空摄影推迟到星期五。

entries.en: She switched from pure mathematics to aerophysics after an internship with an aircraft designer.
entries.zh: 在一位飞机设计师那里实习后，她从纯数学转向了航空物理学。

entries.en: The team collected aeroplankton above the field without identifying individual species.
entries.zh: 研究小组在田地上方采集了空气浮游生物，但没有鉴定具体物种。

entries.en: A protective stand supported the heavy aerosiderite inside the display case.
entries.zh: 展示柜里，一个保护支架托着那块沉重的陨铁。

entries.en: The collector refused to cut the aerosiderolite merely to make it easier to display.
entries.zh: 那位收藏者不肯仅为了便于展示，就把那块陨铁石切开。

entries.en: We listened to Aerosmith while sorting the boxes in the garage.
entries.zh: 我们一边整理车库里的箱子，一边听史密斯飞船乐队的音乐。

entries.en: The probe's instruments began transmitting before it left the Earth's aerosphere.
entries.zh: 探测器还没离开地球大气圈，其仪器就开始传送数据了。

entries.en: She taught aerostation to the new balloon crew throughout the summer.
entries.zh: 整个夏天，她都在教新来的气球队员操纵浮空器。

entries.en: The aerostats looked like tiny dots high above the valley.
entries.zh: 那些高空气球在山谷上方的高空中看起来像小小的圆点。

entries.en: The researchers designed a test to separate aerotaxis from random movement.
entries.zh: 研究人员设计了一项试验，以区分趋氧性运动与随机运动。

entries.en: Her supervisor suggested more thermodynamics before she attempted the advanced course in aerothermochemistry.
entries.zh: 她的导师建议她先多学一些热力学，再去尝试气动热化学高级课程。

entries.en: Our study of aerothermoelasticity required close cooperation between the materials and flight-dynamics groups.
entries.zh: 我们的气动热弹性力学研究需要材料组和飞行动力学组密切合作。

entries.en: The biologist wanted to distinguish aerotropism from responses to light in the experiment.
entries.zh: 那位生物学家想在实验中区分向气性与对光的反应。

entries.en: Ice had stopped the aerovane's propeller during the night.
entries.zh: 夜间，冰阻住了风向风速仪的螺旋桨，使它停转了。

entries.en: She placed the aeschynite beside the quartz before photographing both specimens.
entries.zh: 她把易解石放在石英旁边，然后给两块标本拍照。

entries.en: The photographer hoped to capture an aestivator on camera before its period of dormancy.
entries.zh: 那位摄影师希望在夏蛰动物进入休眠期之前拍到它。

entries.en: The student photographed the aethalium without removing it from the log.
entries.zh: 学生给那枚块状复孢囊拍了照，没有将它从原木上取下。

entries.en: Afan waited beside the lift while I fetched the spare key.
entries.zh: 我去取备用钥匙时，阿凡在电梯旁等着。

entries.en: Afandi replaced the torn page marker with a folded bus ticket.
entries.zh: 阿凡迪用一张折好的公交车票替换了破损的书签。

entries.en: Aferdita asked us to leave the muddy boots outside.
entries.zh: 阿费尔迪塔让我们把沾泥的靴子留在外面。

entries.en: Affandi carried the sleeping child upstairs without turning on the lights.
entries.zh: 阿凡迪没有开灯，就把睡着的孩子抱上了楼。

entries.en: Her affectlessness when the child began to cry disturbed everyone nearby.
entries.zh: 那个孩子哭起来时，她表现得冷酷无情，让周围的人都感到不安。

entries.en: The comedy skewers affluenza through a family obsessed with ever larger houses.
entries.zh: 这部喜剧通过一个痴迷于越来越大房子的家庭，讽刺了追逐财富的“富贵病”。

entries.en: Affo found his missing glasses underneath the folded tablecloth.
entries.zh: 阿福在折好的桌布下面找到了丢失的眼镜。

entries.meaningZh: 阿芙佳朵；冰激凌咖啡〔意大利借词〕
entries.en: My affogato had almost melted by the time the bill arrived.
entries.zh: 账单送来时，我的冰激凌咖啡几乎化完了。

entries.en: The company arranged affreightment before announcing the delivery date.
entries.zh: 那家公司先安排了租船运货，之后才公布交货日期。

entries.en: The courier left the parcel at Affymetrix's reception desk.
entries.zh: 快递员把包裹留在了昂飞公司的前台。

entries.meaningZh: 女爱好者〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: As a jazz aficionada, Elena recognised the tune before anyone else.
entries.zh: 作为爵士乐女爱好者，埃琳娜比其他人都先认出了那段曲调。

entries.en: Afif offered to carry the spare chairs back to the hall.
entries.zh: 阿菲夫主动提出把多余的椅子搬回大厅。

entries.en: Afra noticed a loose button on the coat I had borrowed.
entries.zh: 阿芙拉注意到我借来的外套上有一粒松动的纽扣。

entries.en: In the tale, an afreet guards the bridge until sunrise.
entries.zh: 故事中，一个恶魔守着那座桥，直到日出。

entries.en: An African-American from our neighbourhood joined the school board.
entries.zh: 我们街区的一位非裔美国人加入了校董会。

entries.meaningZh: 非洲历史文化资料〔复数〕
entries.en: The library's Africana include maps donated by a local collector.
entries.zh: 图书馆的非洲历史文化资料中包括一位当地收藏者捐赠的地图。

entries.en: Africanus bought two small pots for the plants on his balcony.
entries.zh: 阿弗里卡纳斯为阳台上的植物买了两个小花盆。

entries.en: Afrikan wrote the new address on the back of an envelope.
entries.zh: 阿夫里坎把新地址写在了一个信封的背面。

entries.en: The story's afrit refuses every gift except a single silver coin.
entries.zh: 故事中的恶魔拒绝所有礼物，只肯收一枚银币。

entries.en: The linguist studied Afro-Asiatic before choosing a language for her fieldwork.
entries.zh: 那位语言学家先研究了亚非语系，再选择田野调查的目标语言。

entries.en: Several Afro-Caribbeans on the committee helped organise the neighbourhood exhibition.
entries.zh: 委员会中的几位非裔加勒比人帮忙筹办了社区展览。

entries.en: Afrocentrism shaped the exhibition's emphasis on African perspectives rather than European interpretations.
entries.zh: 非洲中心论影响了这场展览，使其侧重非洲视角，而不是欧洲的阐释。
